meeting.title: QDI Surfaces + Salesforce + Dataskate: Sales Process Deep-Dive

content.speaker: Fatih Surmen
content.text:
There are different ways, actually. We are looking at it. So one way is the first way is we have established customers, the customers established already, we have the records, we have the sales off of that customer.
So we want to know what we do with that customer, are we visiting with them, what are their concerns, what are we doing good for them? The second thing is brand new efforts, right? That we don't have the customer yet it's not an established account, a brand new account. We want to measure that effort too.
So okay, we have X amount of established customers, but there are so many more out there that we want to earn their business. What do we do on their end? Are we spending 80% of our time on our established customers?
Only two goes to the rest. So that is a separate effort. It needs to be separated basically so we can understand. The other way is online. Yes, we have customers that can request inquiries online. We do not... Other than Google Sheets, we don't have software that gathers that information and does anything with that sorry.

content.speaker: Nick Lydon
content.text: Just want to make sure I'm understanding correctly. When you were saying that when customers make requests, you're not documenting that anywhere outside of Excel, correct?

content.speaker: Fatih Surmen
content.text: The request is about, you know, if we have this product or if they can match something in their world and you know, that kind of requests actually.

content.text: I mean that to me. Is that not something you would want to document so that fatigue reaches out to me and wants to know about a certain type of courts we have? content.text: Correct.

Those are all things we can take action on once it's in the system.

content.text:

content.text: Yes, we have that too. Yes.
